input.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
input.reasoning_summary: The claim asserts that P&G's first quarter of fiscal 2027 showed "broad-based momentum," which is a qualitative/interpretive statement about business performance. The evidence provided does not contain any information about fiscal 2027 Q1 results or performance. The most recent filing in the evidence is a 10-Q filed on 2026-10-22 for the period ending 2026-09-30 (E5), which would be fiscal 2027 Q1 (P&G's fiscal year ends June 30, so Q1 FY2027 would be July-September 2026). However, this filing only discusses the Thorne acquisition completion and the ongoing restructuring plan - it does not provide any financial results, revenue growth, margin performance, or other metrics that would support or contradict a claim about "broad-based momentum." Without actual Q1 FY2027 financial results or management commentary about business momentum in the evidence, there is insufficient evidence to verify this interpretive claim about business performance.
